text:
marta: Quick sync on sidebar IA — support says users repeatedly hunt in two places for the same action (e.g., 'create deploy' appears under Models and Deploys). Thinking of regrouping into task clusters: Build | Deploy | Run | Observe. Opinions?

chen: Task clusters make sense for mental model. One caution: a lot of existing help docs link to /models/... We need stable canonical paths and redirects.

rahul: Agree. Propose canonical routes that survive IA changes, and a redirect table mapping old routes -> new. Example canonical: /projects/:pid/build/models/:mid and /projects/:pid/deploys/:did. Keep shortlinks like /m/:mid for support.

zoe: From design: show both cluster (Build) and resource (Models) in breadcrumbs so users understand mapping. Breadcrumb: Projects / Build / Models / ResNet50. Also add interactive crumbs to jump back to cluster level.

marta: Accessibility note: when user opens a deep link, focus should land on H1 and we should announce the route change to screen readers. Also ensure sidebar collapse state is preserved via aria-expanded.

chen: Keyboard nav: add section shortcuts (Alt+1..4) and Ctrl+K fuzzy search to jump to resources. Implement aria-hidden when sidepanel is collapsed.

rahul: Routing details: nested route plan using React Router v6. Use query params for transient UI state: ?panel=open&modal=train. For shareable modal links we should encode them as query params so server-side rendering can still render initial state.

zoe: UX nit: breadcrumbs should not be too long on small screens. Use ellipsis and show full path on hover. On mobile, collapse to a single back button + a contextual label.

marta: Analytics: tag events with old_path and new_cluster to help measurement during rollout. E.g., {event: "nav_click", old_path: "/models", cluster: "Build"}. Keep event keys stable.

route-bot: redirect-check: discovered 12 external docs linking to /deployments/create. Marking for bulk redirect.

chen: Plan:
- design: update Figma and show focus states (zoe)
- infra: redirect mapping + shortlink service (rahul)
- frontend: implement nested routes, breadcrumbs, keyboard shortcuts (chen + eng)
- accessibility: audit and tests (marta + a11y)

zoe: I'll upload frames by EOD and include responsive examples.

rahul: We'll draft a migration doc and publish redirect list. Need PM approval before we flip redirects.

marta: Thumbs? React :thumbsup: if good, :eyes: if you want to review migration doc first.

chen: :thumbsup:
zoe: :thumbsup:
rahul: :eyes: (will post migration timeline)

marta: Thanks — I'll book a short follow-up to confirm rollout dates.
